text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me... —Alright, let's do 
this.
One day. On my way back from shopping...
choice_data_list: Huh? The one over there is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thank you as always to all my viewers♪ 
It's Nice Nature~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! A memorable catchphrase! The shy 
look fits nicely too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So cuuute~♪ I want everyone to see this 
totally different side of Nature-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaargh!! This is completely out of 
character! It's way too embarrassing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I gotta do it. ...I'll do it. 
Hey, one more time!

Though curious about what was going on... 
I quietly left the area.
Then, on another day.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Next, give me a three-hit combo appeal for 
the camera. Make the outfit pop too. 
Alright, start!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (This is so insanely embarrassinggg...!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Why does someone like me have to do 
this...! Still, I gotta do my best... 
Uuu~~)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Usual me is sealed away! See this through 
to the end, meeeee!!)

Afterwards, wherever I went, I kept 
spotting Nice Nature acting quite 
different from her usual self...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I've got some great tips for 
everyone! Wanna hear? You totally wanna 
hear, right~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, what is it? I'm super curious~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The rest will be on the next stream! Look 
forward to it♪ Alright then, bye-bye-cha~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaand, cut! That's a wrap!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Did I talk properly? To be 
honest, I was completely overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It was spot on! That Trainer over there 
was totally captivated too♪

I ended up watching intently, but given 
Nice Nature's personality, she probably 
didn't want to be seen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, what you just saw...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How was it just now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective as my Trainer, 
y'know. I was just wondering... what you 
thought of me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... Yeah, figures. The usual me is 
completely the opposite of perky and 
sparkly, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I figured if I'm gonna do it, I 
might as well go all the way. For example—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, thank you so much for the 
helpful feedback-cha♪ ............

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Gwaaaahh!! Pretend I never did that 
just now...!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh, putting it so straightforwardly...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know it doesn't suit me at all, and it's 
insanely embarrassing. But...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'd definitely regret not trying. Doing it 
is a momentary shame, not doing it is a 
lifelong regret... or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll do it. Keep your expectations 
high for the next Nice Nature... okay!
